To: Amy Alvarez
Cc: James Grant; Sandra Fuentes

A short update before our next call. The search for {{fact:f:E-2019-001.client}} is moving on schedule, and I wanted you to have the shape of it in writing. James Grant has the market map nearly closed, and I have good early research on the seats we most want to reach. We are still at the stage of building the field rather than narrowing it, which is where a search of this kind should be at this point.

Two things would help from your side. First, a short read from the Howard, Carlson and Tran board on the two priorities we flagged in the draft specification, so I am not researching against a brief that has quietly shifted. Second, a note of any names inside your own network you would want us to include or to avoid. The candidate profiles I prepare will reach your committee under my name, Nicole Donovan, so please send any questions on them straight to me.

On timing, we are comfortably inside the window we set at the start. Once the map is closed this week, I will send a proposed date for our first proper review of where the field is heading, and we can fit it around your calendar rather than ours.
